overall: The AG found the Bridgewater Conservation Commission violated the Open Meeting Law by issuing June 13, 2024 minutes that omitted a 10-minute peer review discussion, and ordered amended minutes certified within 30 days.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the June 13, 2024 minutes were insufficiently specific because they omitted a roughly 10-minute discussion about the third-party peer review process for a notice of intent.
allegations.key_passage: However, the minutes do not include any reference to this discussion.

allegations.summary: Not alleged. The AG noted in a footnote that the June 13, 2024 minutes were not approved until January 9, 2025, and reminded the Commission of timely-approval duties.
allegations.key_passage: These meeting minutes must be reviewed and approved in a timely manner.

remedy: Amend the minutes of the June 13, 2024 meeting in conformance with the letter and certify to the AG within 30 days that it has done so.
Immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law; future similar violations may be considered evidence of intent to violate the law.
note: Read by a language model from the letter; every key passage is checked verbatim against it and dropped if not. A holding is the Attorney General’s reading of the law in this case only.
